preflight:
WITH schema_acl AS (
 SELECT n.oid,n.nspname,coalesce(bool_or(a.privilege_type='USAGE') FILTER (WHERE a.grantee=0),false) AS public_usage,
 coalesce(bool_or(a.privilege_type='CREATE') FILTER (WHERE a.grantee=0),false) AS public_create
 FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace n LEFT JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.aclexplode(coalesce(n.nspacl,pg_catalog.acldefault('n',n.nspowner))) a ON true
 WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_toast%' AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_temp%'
 GROUP BY n.oid,n.nspname
), accessible_relations AS (
 SELECT count(DISTINCT c.oid)::int AS count FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN schema_acl s ON s.oid=c.relnamespace AND s.public_usage
 JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.aclexplode(coalesce(c.relacl,pg_catalog.acldefault('r',c.relowner))) a ON a.grantee=0
 WHERE c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f')
), accessible_definers AS (
 SELECT count(DISTINCT p.oid)::int AS count FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN schema_acl s ON s.oid=p.pronamespace AND s.public_usage
 JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,pg_catalog.acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a ON a.grantee=0 AND a.privilege_type='EXECUTE'
 WHERE p.prosecdef
), db_acl AS (
 SELECT array_agg(a.privilege_type ORDER BY a.privilege_type) AS public_privileges
 FROM pg_catalog.pg_database d JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.aclexplode(coalesce(d.datacl,pg_catalog.acldefault('d',d.datdba))) a ON a.grantee=0
 WHERE d.datname=current_database()
)
SELECT json_build_object('database',current_database(),'reader_exists',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname='sf_gov_schema_reader'),
 'public_relation_access',(SELECT count FROM accessible_relations),'public_definer_access',(SELECT count FROM accessible_definers),
 'public_schema_create',(SELECT coalesce(json_agg(nspname ORDER BY nspname) FILTER (WHERE public_create),'[]'::json) FROM schema_acl),
 'public_database_privileges',(SELECT public_privileges FROM db_acl)) AS reader_preflight;
publicRelations:
WITH s AS (
 SELECT n.oid,n.nspname FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace n
 WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_toast%' AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_temp%'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(coalesce(n.nspacl,pg_catalog.acldefault('n',n.nspowner))) a WHERE a.grantee=0 AND a.privilege_type='USAGE')
)
SELECT nspname AS schema,c.relname,c.relkind,array_agg(DISTINCT a.privilege_type ORDER BY a.privilege_type) AS public_privileges
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN s ON s.oid=c.relnamespace
JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.aclexplode(coalesce(c.relacl,pg_catalog.acldefault('r',c.relowner))) a ON a.grantee=0
WHERE c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f')
GROUP BY nspname,c.relname,c.relkind ORDER BY nspname,c.relname;
dependencies:
SELECT json_build_object(
 'net_schema_owner',(SELECT pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(nspowner) FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace WHERE nspname='net'),
 'public_net_functions',(SELECT coalesce(json_agg(p.proname ORDER BY p.proname),'[]'::json)
 FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='net'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,pg_catalog.acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a WHERE a.grantee=0 AND a.privilege_type='EXECUTE')),
 'catalog_callers',(SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',p.proname,'owner',pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'security_definer',p.prosecdef) ORDER BY n.nspname,p.proname),'[]'::json)
 FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
 WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema','net') AND p.prokind IN ('f','p')
 AND (p.prosrc ILIKE '%net.http_%' OR p.prosrc ILIKE '%net.http_request_queue%' OR p.prosrc ILIKE '%net._http_response%'))
) AS net_dependency_inventory;
execution:
SELECT json_build_object(
 'extension_version',(SELECT extversion FROM pg_catalog.pg_extension WHERE extname='pg_net'),
 'net_schema_grants',(SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('role',CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,'privilege',a.privilege_type)),'[]'::json)
 FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace n JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.aclexplode(coalesce(n.nspacl,pg_catalog.acldefault('n',n.nspowner))) a ON true WHERE n.nspname='net'),
 'direct_net_cron_callers',(SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('jobid',jobid,'username',username,'database',database,'active',active) ORDER BY jobid),'[]'::json)
 FROM cron.job WHERE command ILIKE '%net.http_%' OR command ILIKE '%net.http_request_queue%' OR command ILIKE '%net._http_response%')
) AS net_execution_inventory;
